disposition.head: ccfc1b8ff34cb63f018fb943e75c9f18b94250fc
disposition.response: The final_step field is the measured-region endpoint, paired with measured final_loss and distinct from separately reported profile.steps; fresh maintained review confirms source establishes this contract.

maintained_response.head: ccfc1b8ff34cb63f018fb943e75c9f18b94250fc
evidence: The first production dispatch advances the state once (lines463-469); diagnostic training uses a separate copied state (421-448). Warmup advances it warmup_steps more (482-485), and measured_steps advances it again (488-495).

Measured trajectory is materialized and final_step captured together at the end of that measured region (498-500). Optional profile updates follow (502-512), with trace annotation numbers based on the captured measured endpoint.

The report pairs final_step with final_loss=measured_step_losses[-1], measured timing, and a separate profile.steps field (513-524). Only report and diagnostics are returned (533); no terminal training model/checkpoint is returned under that field.

The existing regression example has first1+warmup1+measured3=5 and profile2; it requires final_step5 and separately profile.steps2, with measured-only timing and trajectory (test lines20-59). This agrees with the source region boundaries and independently corroborates intended semantics; the conclusion does not rest on test passage.
Both reviewed files are byte-identical to PR24 base1186 and outside the ten-file dropout contribution. No source evidence promises final_step means post-profile terminal step.
maintained_response.smallest_warranted_response: Record the catalog item as non-actionable with the measured-endpoint definition. Keep source, report schema, benchmark tests, experiment inputs and pinned scientific evidence unchanged. A wording clarification can be considered only if a real consumer requires terminal-step semantics; none was identified in this source audit.
maintained_response.p1_scope: No change to full-adapter contract: named/native active p>0 requires a key; inference is keyless, p1 with key drops all adapter input. Standalone Haliax helper ordering is not full named LoRA contract.
maintained_response.limits: Read-only source assessment. No services, tests, source edits, scientific reruns or modifications to measurement-source/evaluator pins.
